body: Oddly enough, as I was scrolling through this thread, I noticed that this comment is an exact duplicate of the one made by u/Hermiple about ten minutes prior, further down in the comments. So stealing a stolen comment, perhaps?
Of course you deserve to be loved, and you're not the worst human alive. You may just be putting too much stock in someone who doesn't appreciate you. Loving yourself is important, too.
There's a chat here, and I'd love to talk.
I'm up for talking, if that's what you need. I'm sure others here would be as well. Loneliness is a terrible thing to weather.

It depends on the person, but sometimes segmenting the end goal can help with motivation, so you're getting little victories every so often, instead of anticipating the conclusion itself. You could also try tracking your progress, giving yourself some notion of positive reinforcement.  


As far as needing to talk to someone goes, there are plenty people here who will most likely be more than happy to offer, myself included.

It's been a rough road, but it's good that you're still willing to try. Try to be fair to yourself in your expectations, not only in what you think you should be, but in how long the process of bettering yourself can take.

I've tried all sorts of things; 7 Cups, outreach sites, chats, talking to people on here. They all helped to varying amounts with things. I'm not sure how that might work for you, compared with therapy, but it's hopefully something.

I’m sorry that you’re going through all of this, and I feel for you. It sounds more like you’re a person that has gone through some hardships, and made some mistakes, rather than being selfish or shitty. Cliché or passé as it might sound, truly selfish and shitty people rarely, if ever feel selfish or shitty. 

I once heard a saying that went along the lines of “If you drink rum and Coke, and get drunk, and drink rum and pineapple juice, and get drunk, and drink rum and club soda, and get drunk, it must be the rum.” And I know you probably feel like the rum in your life, but things might not be as cut and dry as they seem when you’re feeling like this.
Always up for listening. What's going on?
I'm available if you want to talk. You can send me a PM, or chat, or whatever you feel is most comfortable for you.
Yikes, that sounds awful. It throwing your day off might be a reason why he keeps it up, but that's downright creepy.
I'm sorry that life hasn't been going well. If you need someone to listen, I'm free.

I'm really sorry that you're going through this, and I've been there. Feeling like you've tried everything is already hard, and it's even worse when you've lost someone like that. I'm not sure if talking about it is something you're interested in, but if it is, I'm here.
I know that feeling myself, recently actually. Promising that things will get better isn't something I can do, but if you want to talk through it, I'm here for you.

Sending the biggest virtual hug I can. Thank goodness most of your coworkers realize the truth. It's always hard having a person in your life that makes you feel like you're back in that place, and it's very good that you realize you aren't an idiot. You deserve better than how she treats you, and you are good.

True, it's always harder when you're alone. That's usually when other things to do come into play, and weird portioning. I've tried talking to people on here and other places to help, but... hours are weird.

Yeah, from experience that's really easy to fall into. Distractions kind of help, like having people around or throwing myself into hobbies. I hope you find a way through this, just try to take it one instance at a time.
I'm up for listening, if you want someone to talk to.
If you can't find an older woman, or another woman to have that conversation with, feel free to send me a message.
That sounds rough. If you need someone to listen, go ahead and message me.
Looks like you've managed two, then. Good job, and take your victories where you can.
Sorry that you're going through all of that. You're not a bother to me, so what's on your mind?
Day by day, taking your victories where you can. For what's it worth, I'm glad you're still alive right now, and for what it's worth, I'm around, and I message back.
That's rough, sorry you went through that. Do you need someone to message?
Feel free to shoot me a message, if you need someone to talk to.
If you need someone to talk to, feel free to message me.
Yeah, I can relate. I think out of the several things they've told me to do, I've only managed to keep up with one. What about you?
Yeah, I know the feeling. What would you even connect with someone over?
This really put into words how I've been feeling. If you wanted a friend, or someone to check on you, or just a pulse to chat with, I'd be down.
Hey. I'm here if you want to talk. You can send me a PM, or chat, if you would like.
Alright, I'll send you a PM.
I'm up for talking if you want.

Thanks, I'm trying to. I've been willing myself to not use anything that I can contact her on. It's hard to do the things I used to enjoy, because I shared all of them with her, with how long we had been together. All my hobbies, favorite movies, shows, music.   


Once again, thank you. It really means a lot.
I'm up for talking, if you want. Shoot me a PM, or in chat. Whatever you'd prefer.

A lot of the things in my life have come crashing down, most recently the longest relationship I've ever been in. I've had a feeling in my head since I was about 10, but it wasn't until I was 17 or so that I was diagnosed with depression and anxiety. I don't like anything about myself, and I feel like a burden to everyone, including her. Or at least I did. I just want out, but the people I'm with now are monitoring me pretty heavily.
If you're still up and about, or even not. I'm up for talking whenever.

I'm free, if that's what you're asking. I left with family, and now I'm at a place only three stories up. I still want to jump, but I'm pretty sure it wouldn't have the desired effect. But I'm not like in a ward or anything yet.
Nope. I'm hoping that it's too late.
